General information.Name: market for natural gas liquids
General information.Description: This is a market activity representing the consumption mix of natural gas liquids in the Global geography. The market connects suppliers with consumers of the same product in the same geographical area, grouping producers and imports within the geographical area. The activity starts at the gate of the activities that produce 'natural gas liquids' within the Global geography and ends with the supply of natural gas liquids to consumers. Transport or losses are considered irrelevant for this product. Natural gas liquids is a fossil fuel with a calorific value of 24.624 MJ/kg used as a liquid fuel sourced from unprocessed natural gas, with main applications in domestic fuel for cooking and heating, industrial fuel and plastics raw material.
General information.Tags: market activity, natural gas liquids, fossil fuel, energy market, global supply chain
General information.Technology | Description: Market activity technology representing the aggregation and distribution system for natural gas liquids. The technology groups multiple producers and imports of natural gas liquids within the Global geography and connects them with consumers without additional transport or loss considerations.
